notes: The owner, minutes after looking at the screen: "the individual panels of the portfolio functionality overlap the portfolio selection bar" and "the drop list box and the New Portfolio buttons don't work when you click on them." Both symptoms are one fact. #content is position:absolute; inset:0 and .view is ALSO position:absolute; inset:0, so the control strip — appended as a normal-flow sibling BEFORE the view — was painted underneath it. Visible through .view, which carries no background, and unclickable because .view sat on top eating every pointer event. Visible and dead is the worst shape
